title: 0/1 Knapsack
contract: Each item has positive weight and nonnegative value. Choose each at most once; total weight must not exceed capacity.
optimal: long[] dp=new long[capacity+1];for(int i=0;i<weights.length;i++){for(int c=capacity;c>=weights[i];c--){dp[c]=Math.max(dp[c],dp[c-weights[i]]+values[i]);emit("Update capacity downward so this item is used once","item",i,"capacity",c,"best values",dp);}}return dp[capacity];
reasoning: Enumerate take/skip decisions and reject taking an item heavier than the remaining capacity.
dp[c] is the best value using processed items and at most capacity c.
Descending capacity preserves the previous item row. Ascending capacity would allow reusing the current item and solve unbounded knapsack instead.
